title: The French Lieutenant’s Woman
description: Based on the novel by John Fowles. In the mid-19th century, disgraced woman Sarah Woodruff lives in the coastal town of Lyme Regis and begins a secret affair with a gentleman, Charles Smithson.
altHero: Sarah Woodruff with an intense stare from under a hooded shawl in the dark mist of the ocean
alt1: Charles Smithson on the edge of the sea
alt3: Sarah and Charles sit in the forest and talk
alt4: Sarah writing in candlelight, looking into a mirror on her table
